meta.vantage: github-hosted ubuntu runner to the ap-southeast-2 staging stack; budgets derived here are not comparable to numbers measured from any other vantage

readlist-switch-first.note: budgetMs is baseline.maxMs rounded up to the next 50ms — 4.8% above the worst run the soak saw. That worst run is an outlier: 17 of the 19 landed between 279 and 414ms and the median max was 379ms, so the gate still sits 2.11x the median run. Ratchet target once the listing cache lands — this is the cache-miss arm.

readlist-switch-subsequent.note: budgetMs is baseline.maxMs rounded up to the next 50ms — 10.8% above the worst run the soak saw, the widest margin of the seven. The soak spanned 252 to 406ms with a 337ms median max. Ratchet target once the listing cache lands — this is the cache-hit arm and should fall furthest.

tab-switch-first.note: budgetMs is baseline.maxMs rounded up to the next 50ms — 8.7% above the worst run the soak saw. The soak spanned 281 to 414ms with a 347ms median max. Cache-miss arm of the To-Read/Read switch.

tab-switch-subsequent.note: budgetMs was raised from 400 to 450 after a 20-run soak measured 449ms for this operation, above the 400ms gate. That 449 was a lone outlier 68ms clear of the next worst — the other 19 runs spanned 257 to 381ms with a 332ms median max, and the operation's median max improved from 347 to 331 over the same soak — but the suite's confirmation re-measure reproduced it, so it is a real tail rather than a hiccup. Cache-hit arm of the To-Read/Read switch.

assign-to-readlist.note: budgetMs is baseline.maxMs rounded up to the next 50ms — 4.9% above the worst run the soak saw. The soak spanned 564 to 715ms with a 647ms median max: the slowest operation, and the one that set the run-level worst in 17 of the 19 runs. Ratchet target when the assign response becomes an out-of-band fragment instead of a full reader re-render.

open-article.note: budgetMs is baseline.maxMs rounded up to the next 50ms — 6.4% above the worst run the soak saw. The soak spanned 347 to 564ms with a 414ms median max. Ratchet target when visible cards are prefetched; expect responseStart to collapse on a prefetch hit.

back-to-readlist.note: budgetMs is baseline.maxMs rounded up to the next 50ms — 2.0% above the worst run the soak saw. That worst run is an outlier: 18 of the 19 landed between 327 and 489ms and the median max was 402ms. Ratchet target when the reader exit becomes instant.
